context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 features complete and tested. Commission system: platform 15%, influencer 12%, reseller 5%, auto-settle on delivery enabled. Product Manager role has products/vendor_products/categories permissions but NOT platform_settings/admin_users. Reviews API requires delivered order to create review.
